note: Terms and recurring words of the two Latin versions after the terms pass (composed-g1 … g4). One rendering per Latin word and sense within a version (card G01 b); the decision cards and agreed points are applied as decided. "segments" lists every segment whose Latin contains the word; each was checked against the composed Russian and English (work/tf/verify.py). "terms pass" marks a rendering changed in this pass (details in terms-log.md). cross_version lists the places where the two translators use different Latin words for the same thing and says how the difference is kept visible.
